description: Curated scene packs for AI tools: each pack = one real-world scenario, containing multiple skills. Download zip -> unzip -> drag the skill folders into your AI tool's skills directory.
description_zh: 精选场景包合集：每个场景包 = 一个真实场景，内含多个 skill。下载 zip -> 解压 -> 把 skill 文件夹拖进 AI 工具的 skills 目录即可使用。

source_notes.alirezarezvani/claude-skills (MIT): 33 programming skills curated from https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills (MIT license). Two upstream near-duplicates (database-schema-designer, agent-workflow-designer) were merged into their siblings; unique content was preserved as reference docs.
source_notes.self-authored scenarios: 18 scenario skills authored and maintained in this repo under skills/writing/ (Zhihu, cnblogs, WeChat MP, Juejin, CSDN, Jianshu, Bilibili, Toutiao, Baijiahao, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Douban, V2EX, SegmentFault, OSChina, static-blog deploy, plus a cross-post orchestrator and AI cover-image generator). They encode China-platform-specific automation knowledge that upstream does not cover. See SOURCES.md.

packs.name: AI Agent Development
packs.description: Build production-grade AI agents, design multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, feature flags, and self-evaluation.
packs.description_zh: 构建生产级 AI Agent、设计多 Agent 工作流、MCP 服务、功能开关与自评。

packs.name: AI Media Toolkit
packs.description: Generate videos, images, covers, and music from prompts through a local generation gateway.
packs.description_zh: 通过本地生成网关用提示词生成视频、图片、封面与配乐：文生/图生全流程（提交、轮询、下载交付）。

packs.name: AI Research & Writing
packs.description: Research a topic and turn it into a structured article: multi-round search, outline, draft, edit, SEO.
packs.description_zh: 从选题调研到成稿发布的长文生产链路：多轮检索与报告综合、大纲搭建、初稿撰写、风格润色、关键词与平台规则优化，以及学术选题的研究空白识别与投稿匹配。

packs.name: AI Video Pipeline
packs.name_zh: AI 短视频生产流水线
packs.description: End-to-end short-video production: script, voice, lip-sync, assembly, subtitles, thumbnail.
packs.description_zh: 从脚本到成片的一条龙短视频生产线：脚本撰写、配音合成、口型对齐、剪辑合成、字幕、封面图。六个技能按序衔接，输出可直接发布的竖屏视频。

packs.name: API Development & Testing
packs.description: Review REST API designs and generate integration/contract test suites.
packs.description_zh: 审查 REST API 设计并生成集成/契约测试套件。

packs.name: System Architecture
packs.description: Design system architecture, plan zero-downtime migrations, and navigate monorepos.
packs.description_zh: 设计系统架构、规划零停机迁移、驾驭 monorepo。

packs.name: Audio Studio
packs.description: AI audio production chain: turn a topic or document into a segmented podcast script (spoken words only - TTS reads everything), direct voice synthesis with a voice catalog and per-character casting, and publish with shownotes, timestamped chapters, and platform metadata. Topic in, publishable episode out, no step left dangling.
packs.description_zh: AI 音频生产链条：把选题或文档变成分段播客脚本（纯口播词——TTS 会把一切都读出来），按声音目录做角色选声与合成参数执导，并以 shownotes、时间戳章节、平台元数据收尾发布。选题进、可发布节目出，链条不断头。方法论借鉴 Kokoro/Qwen3-TTS 生态与 Podify/inference.sh 实践并已署名。

packs.name: Chat Prompt Craft
packs.description: Prompt engineering for conversational AI assistants (Doubao, ChatGPT, Kimi, DeepSeek, etc.): one-shot task prompts built on the five-element formula (role + background + task + requirements + format), agent/persona system prompts on the five-section skeleton, reverse constraints that kill filler, and heuristic structural audit.
packs.description_zh: 面向对话式 AI 助手（豆包、ChatGPT、Kimi、DeepSeek 等）的提示词工程：五要素公式（角色 + 背景 + 任务 + 要求 + 格式）写一次性任务提示词，五段骨架写智能体人设 system prompt，反向约束砍废话，附启发式结构审计脚本。方法论提炼自豆包官方教程与 Coze 最佳实践并已署名。

packs.name: CI/CD Pipeline
packs.description: Generate pragmatic CI/CD pipelines, release gates, and spec-driven development workflows.
packs.description_zh: 生成务实的 CI/CD 流水线、发布门禁与规范驱动开发流程。

packs.name: Code Planning & Generation
packs.description: Turn vague requests into structured plans, then into working code; diagnose and fix failures.
packs.description_zh: 把模糊需求变成可执行代码：三层瀑布式意图识别、结构化实施计划、两档代码生成（模板引擎 + LLM）、运行时故障诊断与调试清单。

packs.name: Code Review
packs.description: Review pull requests, analyze code quality, audit dependencies and tech debt across languages.
packs.description_zh: 审查 PR、分析代码质量、审计依赖与技术债，覆盖多语言。

packs.name: Containers & Orchestration
packs.description: Dockerfile optimization, docker-compose, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.description_zh: Dockerfile 优化、docker-compose、Helm Chart 与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Content Publishing Automation
packs.name_zh: 内容多平台发布自动化
packs.description: Publish, edit and manage articles/videos on Chinese platforms (Zhihu, cnblogs, WeChat MP, Juejin, CSDN, Jianshu, Bilibili, Toutiao, Baijiahao, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Douban, V2EX, SegmentFault, OSChina, Douban, Static Blogs) with battle-tested platform knowledge, plus a cross-post orchestrator and AI cover-image generation.
packs.description_zh: 在知乎、博客园、微信公众号、掘金、CSDN、简书、B站、头条、百家号、小红书、微博、豆瓣、V2EX、SegmentFault、开源中国、静态博客等中文平台发布、编辑、管理内容，沉淀实战平台经验；附跨平台发布编排器与 AI 封面图生成。

packs.name: Data, ML & Scientific Computing
packs.description: Data pipelines, feature engineering, mathematical modeling, simulation, and ML training workflows.
packs.description_zh: 数据与建模的完整工具箱：ETL 清洗变换、特征工程、数学建模与求解器选型、蒙特卡洛仿真、结果可视化、ML 训练流水线与超参调优、指标体系解读。

packs.name: Database Design & Management
packs.description: Design schemas, ERD diagrams, migrations, and optimize SQL queries.
packs.description_zh: 设计表结构、ERD 图、迁移方案，并优化 SQL 查询。

packs.name: De-AI Writing
packs.description: Rewrite AI-generated text into natural human writing: trace auditing, humanized rewriting, personal voice profiling.
packs.description_zh: 把 AI 生成文本改写成自然的人味文字：AI 痕迹审计、人性化重写、个人风格画像对齐。让 AI 代笔的内容读起来像你自己写的。

packs.name: Edu Craft
packs.description: Teaching and knowledge-product chain: learning-contract-driven course design with checkpoint breakdown, strict exercise generation (open-ended questions, MCQ banned, rubric included), and a Feynman loop explainer (diagnose, repair, teach-back, transfer). Topic in, mastery-ready course kit out.
packs.description_zh: 教学与知识产品链条：学习契约驱动的课程设计（checkpoint 分解）、严格习题生成（开放题防蒙、附评分标准）、费曼循环讲解器（诊断→修复→回讲→迁移）。主题进、可交付掌握式课程包出。方法论借鉴费曼学习法生态与掌握式学习实践并已署名。

packs.name: GitHub Collaboration
packs.description: Parallel worktrees, conventional-commit changelogs, and PR review on GitHub.
packs.description_zh: 并行 worktree、Conventional Commits 变更日志与 GitHub PR 审查。

packs.name: Growth Marketing
packs.description: E-commerce and growth marketing chain: framework-driven product copy (FAB/PAS/AIDA with objection handling), campaign design with single-variable A/B variant pairs, and channel adaptation with machine-checked fit rules (word budgets, CTA counts per platform). Product facts in, launch-ready channel variants out.
packs.description_zh: 电商与增长营销链条：框架驱动的商品文案（FAB/PAS/AIDA + 异议处理）、单变量 A/B 变体对的活动策划、附机器适配校验（各平台字数预算与 CTA 约束）的渠道适配。商品事实进、可投放渠道变体出。方法论借鉴 AIDA/PAS/FAB 直复营销框架与开源营销技能生态并已署名。

packs.name: Homework Autopilot
packs.description: One-shot homework completion pipeline with a human voice: assignment intake, per-type solution drafting, rewrite in the student's own words.
packs.description_zh: 一键完成老师布置的任务，但保住人味：审题拆解、分题型作答、再用学生自己的口吻重写。真实素材注入、年级语言水平校准，拒绝冷血模板文。

packs.name: Image Studio
packs.description: End-to-end image creation workspace: prompt engineering, style anchoring, generation via gateway, cover art.
packs.description_zh: 端到端画图工作台：生图提示词工程、风格锚定、网关生图执行、封面图生成。把散落的生图技能组装成一条龙。

packs.name: Incident Response & SRE
packs.description: Command incidents, generate runbooks, and define SLOs/error budgets.
packs.description_zh: 事故指挥、生成 runbook、定义 SLO 与错误预算。

packs.name: Infrastructure as Code
packs.description: Terraform patterns, observability design, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.description_zh: Terraform 模式、可观测性设计与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Memory Systems
packs.description: Design, populate, manage and retrieve long-term memory for AI agents: layered architecture, extraction, lifecycle and hybrid retrieval.
packs.description_zh: 为 AI agent 设计、填充、管理与检索长期记忆：分层架构、记忆抽取、生命周期管理与混合检索。方法论蒸馏自 mem0 / letta (MemGPT) / Claude memory tool。

skills.name: memory-architect
skills.source: mem0 / letta / claude memory tool (methodology distilled)

packs.name: Office Productivity
packs.description: Daily office work: decks, spreadsheets, resumes, meeting minutes.
packs.description_zh: 日常办公四件套：PPT 制作、Excel 清洗分析、简历岗位定制、会议纪要结构化。

packs.name: Performance Profiling
packs.description: Profile CPU/memory/I/O bottlenecks in Node.js, Python, and Go.
packs.description_zh: 剖析 Node.js、Python、Go 的 CPU/内存/IO 瓶颈。

packs.name: Security & Secrets
packs.description: Set up secret vaults and manage environment-variable hygiene.
packs.description_zh: 搭建密钥库并管理环境变量卫生。

packs.name: Skill Forge
packs.description: Meta skills about skills themselves: author a new SKILL.md from a one-batch clarification, lint an existing one against the repo spec with an exit code CI can gate on, and search/pack/stats this repo from real data. Idea in, compliant shipped skill out.
packs.description_zh: 关于技能本身的元技能三件套：一次性问齐需求后生成合规 SKILL.md（skill-author）、八项静态检查并返回可做 CI 门禁的退出码（skill-linter）、基于真实数据检索技能与装配组合（skill-finder）。想法进、可提交的技能出。

packs.name: Test-Driven Development
packs.description: Write unit tests, fixtures, mocks, and guide red-green-refactor cycles.
packs.description_zh: 编写单元测试、fixture、mock，并引导红绿重构循环。

packs.name: Toolsmith
packs.description: Local file and automation chores done safely: reorganize a messy directory with a dry-run planner, batch-rename files with one-command rollback, convert documents/images/media, and schedule recurring jobs across cron/launchd/Task Scheduler.
packs.description_zh: 本地文件与自动化的四件顺手工具：目录体检与整理（含快速判重）、批量重命名（EXIF 日期 + 日志回滚）、文档/图片/音视频格式转换统一入口、定时任务（cron 表达式翻译 + 三平台落地）。全部默认 dry-run、只读优先。

packs.name: Video Design Studio
packs.description: Pre-production design layer for AI video: storyboards with continuity contracts, cinematic shot lists from recipe cards, cross-model text-to-video prompt engineering with structural audit, and reusable visual style anchors with character consistency cards.
packs.description_zh: AI 视频的前期设计层：分镜设计（节拍表 + 逐场景 prompt 对 + 连续性约束表，附机器校验）、12 卡镜头清单设计、跨模型文生视频提示词工程（六槽位结构 + 机器审计）、视觉风格锚与角色一致性卡。方法论借鉴 video-storyboard / video-shotcraft / visual-skills 等开源项目并已署名。

packs.name: Viral Entertainment
packs.description: Special entertainment scenarios: talking-character viral shorts.
packs.description_zh: 特别娱乐场景：AI 宝宝播客等会说话角色的病毒式短视频完整流水线（含合规标识与角色一致性纪律）。

packs.name: Visual Design Studio
packs.description: AI visual design chain: interpret a vague brief into a design spec (purpose, platform size, style anchor), engineer text-to-image prompts with model dialects and text-rendering rules, and audit output against platform layout specs (safe areas, ratios, text budgets). One brief flows through spec -> prompt -> audit without leaving the chain.
packs.description_zh: AI 视觉设计链条：把模糊需求翻译成设计规格单（用途/平台尺寸/风格锚），按模型方言与文字渲染规则写文生图 prompt，并按平台版面规格（比例/安全区/文字预算）审计产出。一条需求从规格到 prompt 到审计全程不出链。方法论借鉴 Anthropic canvas-design / designskills / Replicate prompting 指南并已署名。

skills.name: frontend-design-director
skills.source: methodology distilled from Anthropic public skills (no content copied)
